# stride: every 1th deduplicated non-SSA function
# nfuncs, then per function:
#   frame nparams nblocks ninstrs expect-candidates expect-phis expect-verify
#   nparams 'var typeclass' pairs
#   per block: nsucc succ... ninstr, then the instructions
#   0 nuses use...          no destination
#   1 nuses use... def ty   facts add-def-ty
#   2 nuses use... def      facts add-def-bad
#   3 nuses use... def      addr_of: def bad, use[0] poisoned
#   4 nuses use... def      pack/word: defines def, facts skip
#   5 def ty nin (val pred)*  lowerer phi (val -1 = constant)
# ty: |ty| interns the printed type, ty > 0 is opt-ssa-register-value-type?
